exclusions.en: Cross-member only; domestic, young-animal, booster, tattoo and destination exceptions remain separately unreviewed.

scope_note.en: Readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 needs separate identification review.

summary.en: Cross-member identification, rabies, passport and accompaniment conditions; this page does not govern travel entirely inside one member.

message.en: Microchip identification or reading must not follow rabies vaccination.
message.zh-CN: 芯片识别或读取日期不得晚于狂犬病接种日期。
